title: Main Quest
description: The Dragonborn's story: from the execution at Helgen to the battle with Alduin in Sovngarde.

items.title: Unbound
items.description: A dragon attack interrupts your execution at Helgen. Escape the burning keep with one of two companions.
tips: Your choice of companion doesn't commit you to his side in the Civil War.
Grab the spell tomes and lockpicks in the torture room — they help early on.

choices.question: Who do you follow out of Helgen?

options.label: Ralof (Stormcloaks)
options.result: Ralof takes you to his sister Gerdur in Riverwood and invites you to join the Stormcloaks in Windhelm.

options.label: Hadvar (Imperial Legion)
options.result: Hadvar takes you to his uncle Alvor, the Riverwood blacksmith, and invites you to join the Legion in Solitude.

items.title: Before the Storm
items.description: Warn Jarl Balgruuf of Whiterun about the dragon that attacked Helgen.
tips: Near Riverwood you can take one of the Guardian Stones: the Warrior, the Mage or the Thief.

items.title: Bleak Falls Barrow
items.description: Retrieve the Dragonstone from an ancient barrow for the court wizard Farengar.
tips: Arvel the Swift carries the Golden Claw, which opens the ring-puzzle door (the answer is on the claw's palm).
At the end of the barrow is your first Word Wall (a word of Unrelenting Force).

items.title: Dragon Rising
items.description: Fight off the dragon Mirmulnir at the watchtower. Absorbing his soul reveals that you are Dragonborn.
tips: Afterwards the Jarl names you Thane of Whiterun, assigns Lydia as your housecarl and lets you buy Breezehome.

items.title: The Way of the Voice
items.description: Climb the 7,000 Steps to the Greybeards at High Hrothgar and pass their trials of the Voice.
tips: The Greybeards teach you words of Unrelenting Force and Whirlwind Sprint.

items.title: The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller
items.description: Retrieve the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from Ustengrav. In its place you find a note: someone took it and wants to meet you in Riverwood.
tips: The note leads to the Sleeping Giant Inn — rent the attic room there.

items.title: A Blade in the Dark
items.description: Delphine of the Blades tests you: together you must stop the dragon Sahloknir from rising at Kynesgrove.
tips: This is where you first see Alduin raising dragons from their burial mounds.

items.title: Diplomatic Immunity
items.description: Sneak into the reception at the Thalmor Embassy near Solitude and find out what the Thalmor know about the dragons' return.
tips: Malborn can smuggle in a few items for you; the rest of your gear stays in Delphine's chest.
The embassy holds Thalmor dossiers, including ones on Ulfric and Delphine.

items.title: A Cornered Rat
items.description: Find Esbern, an old Blade hiding from the Thalmor in the Ratway beneath Riften.
tips: Ask Brynjolf or Keerava at the Bee and Barb, then Vekel the Man at the Ragged Flagon in the Ratway.

items.title: Alduin's Wall
items.description: Travel with Esbern and Delphine to Sky Haven Temple in the Reach and study Alduin's Wall.
tips: Afterwards the temple becomes the Blades' base, where you can recruit new members.

items.title: The Throat of the World
items.description: Arngeir teaches you the Clear Skies shout so you can pass through the storm to the dragon Paarthurnax at the summit.
tips: Paarthurnax teaches you a word of Fire Breath.

items.title: Elder Knowledge
items.description: Find the Elder Scroll (Dragon). Septimus Signus points the way through Alftand and Blackreach to the Tower of Mzark.
tips: Septimus Signus gives you the Attunement Sphere needed to get in.
Blackreach is huge and full of Falmer and Dwarven automatons — stock up on potions.

items.title: Alduin's Bane
items.description: Read the Elder Scroll at the summit, learn the Dragonrend shout and face Alduin for the first time.
tips: After the quest you can sell the Elder Scroll to Urag gro-Shub at the College of Winterhold.

items.title: Season Unending
items.description: Optional: if the Civil War isn't over, Jarl Balgruuf refuses to help trap a dragon until there's a truce. The peace talks take place at High Hrothgar.
tips: If the Civil War is already over, this quest is skipped automatically.
A truce is signed whatever you choose — your choices only decide who gets which holds.
items.missable: Holds handed over in the treaty change jarls immediately; some jarls and their quests may become unavailable.

choices.question: How do you split the holds at the negotiations?

options.label: Favor the Empire
options.result: Markarth always goes to the Stormcloaks, while the Empire gets Riften and/or Dawnstar and Winterhold; Ulfric pays compensation for Karthwasten.

options.label: Favor the Stormcloaks
options.result: The Stormcloaks get Markarth, Morthal and/or Falkreath; the Empire gets minimal concessions.

options.label: Balanced
options.result: Each side gets roughly equal concessions; both complain but sign the treaty.

items.title: The Fallen
items.description: Use the dragon Odahviing's name to lure him into the trap at Dragonsreach and learn where Alduin is hiding.
tips: After the quest you can use the Call Dragon shout to summon Odahviing.

items.title: The World-Eater's Eyrie
items.description: Odahviing flies you to the temple of Skuldafn. Fight your way to the portal to Sovngarde, where Alduin has fled.
tips: You can't leave Skuldafn until the quest is done — prepare beforehand.
The portal opens with the staff of the dragon priest Nahkriin.

items.title: Sovngarde
items.description: Pass through Alduin's mist to the Hall of Valor and gain the help of Tsun and three ancient heroes.
tips: You can meet the souls of fallen heroes here — for example Kodlak, if you cleansed his soul in the Companions' "Glory of the Dead".
items.missable: You can't return to Sovngarde after finishing the main quest.

items.title: Dragonslayer
items.description: The final battle with Alduin alongside Gormlaith, Felldir and Hakon. After the victory you return to the Throat of the World.
tips: Use Dragonrend to bring Alduin down and clear the mist.

items.title: Paarthurnax
items.description: The Blades demand you kill Paarthurnax for his past crimes and refuse to help while he lives. You can leave this quest unfinished.
tips: You can put off the decision as long as you like, even after the ending.
items.missable: Killing Paarthurnax is permanent: the Greybeards will stop talking to you.

options.label: Kill
options.result: The Blades work with you again, but the Greybeards turn their backs on you.

options.label: Spare
options.result: Paarthurnax stays on the Throat of the World; Delphine and Esbern refuse any further help or Blades quests.

items.title: Rebuilding the Blades
items.description: Recruit up to three new Blades and bring them to Sky Haven Temple.
tips: Followers you've already hired qualify (except special ones).

items.title: Greybeards' Favor
items.description: As long as Paarthurnax lives, the Greybeards keep talking to you and Paarthurnax stays at the summit of the Throat of the World.
tips: If you plan to kill Paarthurnax, learn everything you need from the Greybeards first.
items.missable: Lost forever if you kill Paarthurnax.
